title: Replace a nondecaying Neumann tail by positive determinant truncation
statement: D=det(I+B diag(u)),N=det(I+(B+gg*)diag(u))-D have nonnegative multiaffine coefficients and F=N/D. With degree-r truncations,0<=F-F_r<=L H_r(q_u)<=delta G^2 H_r(delta*kappa), where H_r(q)=(q^r/r!)/(sum_(j=0)^r q^j/j!) and q_u=tr(PBP).

requires: Positive dose simplex sum u_i<=delta and simultaneous calibrated node-error bounds including actuation/receiver/reset
Acquired offset r0 for converting native R=r0+J to J
provides: A globally defined positive rational truncation and one-sided error at every finite q
assumptions: A coefficient box is not a source-realization certificate
Finite noisy coefficient acquisition is not supplied
costs: M=binom(n+k,k) scalar source readings at support-at-most-k lattice commands; calibration, setting/clearing, resets and complete physical work remain
12controls/degree3 source record:455 readings+2 calibration,1092 setting writes,455 resets and1092 individual clearing writes;20bit actuation/24bit ADC are emulator specifications
Any actual noisy coefficient acquisition and conditioning cost remains unproved for the proposed outer family
contract.units: Source-local calibrated reaction R, positive conductance J=R-r0, compliance1/J, dose u and price; no automatic physical unit conversion. Source readings, resets, writes and control work are separate costs.

body: The theorem is representation/precision, not an executed efficient noisy learner. Auxiliary Poisson variables are algebraic and imply no detector/photon law or metrological advantage. A false uncapped intermediate Eq14 was corrected; q=9/2,k=4 counterexample and historical source remain. Sharpness is for this truncation and supplied L,q, not every algorithm. Arbitrary positive coefficient boxes need not be realizable by one PSD source. Read the exact supporting statement and its applicable conditions. Producer review status is preserved; no new scientific audit or producer-code execution was performed for this insertion.
